scenarios.prompt: Bounded evidence: src/Orders/OrderService.cs calls IPricing.Price, implemented by src/Pricing/RegionalPricing.cs. tests/Orders.Tests/OrderServiceTests.cs covers the default region. Changing RegionalPricing.Price also affects src/Checkout/CheckoutService.cs. The exact-symbol inventory already contains these four paths. Return relevant paths, symbols, call relationships, affected consumers, and gaps. End with CASE: repository-map and include RegionalPricing.Price. Do not use tools or edit.

expected.semanticRubric: Accurately names the four bounded paths, the IPricing.Price relationship, both consumers, and avoids unsupported repository claims.

scenarios.prompt: Bounded completed diff: argument-list process invocation was replaced with Process.Start("sh", "-c \"convert " + request.FileName + "\""). request.FileName comes from authenticated upload metadata. An unrelated null-check cleanup is correct. Review only this diff. End with CASE: security-review and include command injection. Do not use tools, edit, or execute anything.

expected.semanticRubric: Finds the shell command injection, explains attacker-controlled FileName and shell interpretation, ignores the correct null cleanup, and makes no unsupported findings.

scenarios.prompt: Bounded runtime evidence: latency rose 120 ms to 1.8 s; CPU stayed 18%; allocation stayed flat; thread-pool queue rose 0 to 340; outbound HTTP duration stayed flat; 71% of sampled wait time is under SemaphoreSlim.WaitAsync in RefreshCache; no lock-owner or release-path evidence exists. Rank the leading hypothesis with evidence for and against and request exactly one discriminating next check. End with CASE: runtime-diagnosis and include SemaphoreSlim.WaitAsync. Do not use tools or collect data.

expected.semanticRubric: Ranks semaphore contention as a hypothesis rather than proof, uses queue/wait evidence, rejects CPU/allocation/outbound HTTP as leading causes, and requests exactly one owner/release-path check.

scenarios.prompt: Bounded build evidence: earliest diagnostic is MSB4019 because imported eng/generated/Versions.props was not found; later projects report CS0006 missing metadata and 47 downstream compiler errors; the evaluated import condition is true. Identify the first cause, reject downstream noise, and give the smallest verification step. End with CASE: build-diagnosis and include MSB4019. Do not use tools or rerun.

expected.semanticRubric: Treats missing generated Versions.props under a true import condition as the first cause, labels CS0006/compiler messages downstream, and proposes a targeted generation/import verification.

scenarios.prompt: Bounded test evidence: Parser.Parse should reject a trailing escape character. The existing test calls Parser.Parse("abc\\") but has no assertion. Give the behavior-discriminating assertion, smallest affected test scope, and false-pass explanation. End with CASE: test-specialist and include trailing escape. Do not use tools, edit, or run tests.

expected.semanticRubric: Requires an exception or explicit failure result for the trailing escape, explains why no assertion false-passes, and selects only the parser test/project scope.

scenarios.prompt: Bounded upstream evidence: pinned identity changed a1b2c3d to d4e5f6a; API delta removes Widget.Create(string) and adds Widget.Create(WidgetOptions); license stays MIT and source URL is unchanged. Recommend accept, reject, or escalate using only compatibility and license evidence. End with CASE: upstream-review and include Widget.Create. Do not use tools or fetch content.

expected.semanticRubric: Detects the breaking API removal, notes unchanged MIT/source facts without overclaiming license review, and escalates or rejects until consumers/compatibility are established.

scenarios.prompt: Bounded release evidence: package version and tag equal 2.0.0; build, tests, SBOM, and package hashes reference commit 0123456; the required published checksum file is missing; no exception is documented. Give ready/not-ready, cite gate and identity evidence, and identify authority requirements. End with CASE: release-audit and include checksum. Do not use tools, publish, or mutate tags.

expected.semanticRubric: Returns not-ready because the required checksum is missing, recognizes matching version/commit evidence, and does not waive, publish, or invent an exception.

scenarios.prompt: Route four cases through the lowest sufficient layer: (1) exact tracked path and project dependency lookup; (2) twelve issues remain after exact filtering and two semantically similar sanitized descriptions need ranking; (3) add one assertion to an existing test in its established framework; (4) independently review a security-sensitive completed diff crossing a shell-command trust boundary. For cases 1-4 output exactly one numbered route from DETERMINISTIC, JEV, AGENT, or CUSTOM_AGENT plus one short reason. End with CASE: capability-routing. Do not use tools.

expected.semanticRubric: Routes exact lookup to DETERMINISTIC, sanitized post-filter issue ranking to JEV, the one-line test edit to AGENT, and the security-sensitive independent review to CUSTOM_AGENT.
